get.summary: Lists the custom actions in saved order. A new database starts with one action, "Simplify (B2)".

put.summary: Replaces the whole list of custom actions (all or nothing) and returns it with the assigned ids. Actions missing from the request are deleted; the request order is the saved order.

requestBody.description: The new list: at most 20 actions; unique names (ignoring case); each prompt must contain {selection} and only known placeholders.

400.description: The list is invalid; the detail field explains what to fix. Nothing is saved.

get.summary: Lists the audio files of a book, ordered by first chapter. Empty list when there are none.

post.summary: Attaches an audio file to a book: copies it into the data folder and stores its chapter range (default: the whole book). Upload limit: 1 GB per file.

requestBody.description: Last chapter covered (zero-based chapter index, inclusive). Default: the last chapter of the book.

400.description: No file, unsupported type, empty file, a range outside the book, From after To, or a range that overlaps another audio file of the book. Nothing is saved.

put.summary: Changes the chapter range of an audio file.

requestBody.description: The new first and last chapter.

400.description: The range is outside the book, From is after To, or it overlaps another audio file of the book.

404.description: No book or audio file with this id.

delete.summary: Removes an audio file: deletes its database row and the copy in the data folder.

404.description: No book or audio file with this id.

put.summary: Remembers where the listener stopped in an audio file. Changing the chapter range keeps it.

404.description: No book or audio file with this id.

get.summary: Streams the audio file. Supports HTTP range requests (206 Partial Content), so seeking works; use it as the `src` of an audio element.

404.description: No book or audio file with this id, or the stored file is missing.

416.description: The requested range is not satisfiable.

get.summary: Lists all books, last opened first, then most recently imported. Empty list when there are none.

200.description: The books, without chapter or paragraph text.

post.summary: Imports a book from one or more .txt files (merged in natural file-name order): splits it into chapters and paragraphs and stores it.

requestBody.description: The .txt files, sent as repeated `file` parts. They are merged in natural file-name order, not upload order.

400.description: No files, or a file is not .txt, is empty or is not UTF-8 (the detail names the file), or the chapter pattern setting is invalid. Nothing is saved.

get.summary: Lists the chapters of a book in reading order, without paragraph text.

200.description: The book title and its chapters.

get.summary: Gets one whole chapter: its title and all paragraphs in order.

404.description: No book with this id, or no chapter with this index.

get.summary: Gets where the reader stopped in a book; chapter 0, paragraph 0 when nothing is saved. Does not change the last-opened time.

put.summary: Saves where the reader stopped and sets the book's last-opened time to now.

400.description: The chapter does not exist, or the paragraph index is negative or not below the chapter's paragraph count.

delete.summary: Deletes a book together with its chapters and paragraphs.

post.summary: Sorts file names in the order the import merges them (natural order: ch2 before ch10, case-insensitive). Pure function: no files, no database.

200.description: The same names in natural order.

get.summary: Reports that the API is running.
Checks whether the LLM server (Ollama) is reachable. Always returns 200; a problem is reported in the error field.
Lists the names of the installed models.

503.description: Ollama is not reachable; the detail field says how to fix it.

post.summary:
Sends a prompt to the chosen model and streams the answer as Server-Sent Events.
Each chunk is an event with a JSON string as data (for example `data: "Hello"`); the stream ends with `event: done`.
If the model fails after the stream started, an `event: error` with the message as data is sent instead.

400.description: Blank prompt, no model chosen in settings, or the chosen model is not installed.

503.description: Ollama is not reachable; the detail field says how to fix it.

post.summary:
Translates the selected text into the native language (setting `language.native`, Ukrainian by default) and streams the translation.
The prompt is the saved template `prompt.translate` with its placeholders filled. The stream format is the same as in the test endpoint.

400.description: Blank text, no model chosen in settings, or the chosen model is not installed.

503.description: Ollama is not reachable; the detail field says how to fix it.

post.summary:
Explains the selected text in simple English as three lines (Meaning, Grammar, Usage) and streams the answer.
The prompt is the saved template `prompt.explain` with its placeholders filled. The stream format is the same as in the test endpoint.

400.description: Blank text, no model chosen in settings, or the chosen model is not installed.

503.description: Ollama is not reachable; the detail field says how to fix it.

post.summary:
Runs a custom action: its saved prompt template is filled like the Translate and Explain templates and the answer is streamed.
The stream format is the same as in the test endpoint.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the action (from the actions list).

400.description: Blank text, no model chosen in settings, or the chosen model is not installed.

503.description: Ollama is not reachable; the detail field says how to fix it.

get.summary: Gets the scratchpad text (one per app); empty when never saved.

requestBody.description: The new text (may be empty to clear it).

400.description: The text is longer than 200,000 characters. Nothing is saved.

get.summary: Returns all settings as a key/value map. Settings never saved have their default value.

put.summary: Updates one or more settings. The request is all or nothing; returns all settings after the update.

requestBody.description: Key/value map. Only known keys are accepted; values may be at most 1000 characters (4000 for prompt.* keys). language.from: language of the book, default English. language.level: English level A1|A2|B1|B2|C1|C2, default B2. ollama.url: absolute http or https address. prompt.translate and prompt.explain: prompt templates (default = built-in prompt); allowed placeholders: {selection} (required), {sentence}, {paragraph}, {native_language}, {target_language}, {from_language}, {english_level}; an unknown placeholder or a missing {selection} is rejected. reader.fontSize: small|medium|large|xlarge; reader.theme: light|dark; reader.width: narrow|medium|wide; reader.panelWidth: whole number 20-70 (percent, default 40). player.speed: 0.75|1|1.25|1.5, default 1.

400.description: Unknown key or invalid value; the detail field explains what to fix.

get.summary: Returns the default value of every known setting (same shape as the settings list), ignoring saved values. Used to reset a setting, for example a prompt template.
Returns the placeholders a prompt template may use ({name} in the template), with a description each. Single source for the settings UI.
